title: Unit 1.1 Vocabulary Test
subtitle: Meaning, spelling, and vocabulary in context

sections.title: Meaning in Context
sections.description: Choose the option that best explains the highlighted vocabulary.

questions.prompt: The hike to the top of the mountain rewarded us with spectacular scenery. What does “spectacular scenery” mean?
The city of Ely has about 10,000 inhabitants. What does “inhabitants” mean?
options: People who live in a place

questions.prompt: There is a shortage of cheap accommodation in the capital. What does “accommodation” mean?
New York is a very culturally diverse city. What does “diverse” mean?
